recipes.name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients: 2 tsp kosher salt (+ more to taste)
1 tbsp kosher salt (+ more to taste)
1 lb fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined (shells reserved)
To taste: freshly ground black pepper
2 tsp fresh tarragon, chopped (or 2/3 tsp dried)
1 tbsp fresh marjoram, chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
3 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped (or 1 tbsp dried)
instructions: For Simple Shrimp Scampi:
Fill a large pot ⅔ full with water, season with salt, and bring to a boil. - 2 tsp kosher salt (+ more to taste)
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. - 3 tbsp unsalted butter
Add crushed garlic and red pepper flakes. Cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. - 3 garlic cloves crushed - ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes
Add linguine to the boiling water and cook until al dente according to package instructions. - ½ lb linguine pasta
Add white wine to the skillet and cook until reduced by half, about 3-5 minutes. - ½ cup dry white wine
Add shrimp to the skillet, cooking 45 seconds to 1 minute per side until pink. - 1 lb frozen shrimp defrosted
Add lemon juice, stirring to incorporate into the sauce. - 1 large lemon juiced
Drain pasta, reserving ¼ cup of pasta water. - ½ lb linguine pasta - ¼ cup reserved pasta water
Add pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine. If the sauce looks too thin or separated, add the reserved pasta water. - ½ lb linguine pasta - ¼ cup reserved pasta water
Season with salt and pepper. - Salt & pepper to taste
For Complex Shrimp Scampi:
In a medium bowl, toss shrimp with salt and baking soda. Let sit for 20-40 minutes to dry brine. - 1 tsp salt - 1 lb fresh shrimp peeled and deveined (shells reserved) - 1 tsp baking soda

In a small saucepan, combine white wine, bay leaf, peppercorns, and reserved shrimp shells. Simmer until reduced by half, about 5-10 minutes. Strain and set aside. - 1 cup dry white wine - 1 bay leaf - 1 lb fresh shrimp peeled and deveined (shells reserved)
Fill a large pot ⅔ full with water, season with salt, and bring to a boil. - 1 tbsp kosher salt (+ more to taste)
In a medium skillet, melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat. Add panko breadcrumbs and toast until golden, 4-6 minutes. Set aside. - 8 tbsp unsalted butter divided - ½ cup panko breadcrumbs

In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook for 30 seconds per side. Remove shrimp and set aside (they will finish cooking later). - 3 tbsp olive oil - 1 lb fresh shrimp peeled and deveined (shells reserved)

Lower heat to medium, add garlic, red pepper flakes, and shallots to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently. - 7 garlic cloves thinly sliced - ½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes - 1 large shallot minced
Add the reserved wine reduction and continue to cook for 3 minutes.
Cook fettuccine in boiling water according to package directions. - ½ lb fresh fettuccine pasta
Add remaining 6 tbsp butter to the skillet. Once melted, stir in lemon juice. For a smoother sauce, optionally blend with an emulsion machine. - 8 tbsp unsalted butter divided - 2 lemons juiced
Return shrimp to the skillet to finish cooking. - 1 lb fresh shrimp peeled and deveined (shells reserved)
Taste and season the sauce with salt and pepper. - To taste: freshly ground black pepper
Add cooked pasta directly from the pot to the skillet, along with ¼ cup pasta water. Stir until the sauce thickens and becomes glossy. If needed, add more pasta water. - ½ lb fresh fettuccine pasta

Garnish with toasted breadcrumbs, fresh herbs, and lemon zest. Serve immediately. - ½ cup panko breadcrumbs - 2 tsp fresh tarragon chopped (or 2/3 tsp dried) - 1 tbsp fresh marjoram chopped (or 1 tsp dried) - 3 tbsp fresh parsley chopped (or 1 tbsp dried)
